DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届いた連絡について伺います。相手は誰だと名乗っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me ask about the message you received. Who does the sender claim to be?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 弟だという相手から新しい番号で連絡が来ました。携帯が壊れたので今日中に送金してほしいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新番号で弟を名乗り携帯故障を理由に今日の送金を求めたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone claiming to be my younger brother contacted me from a new number. They say their phone broke and want money transferred today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that someone using a new number claims to be your younger brother and requests a transfer today because their phone broke. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 弟さん本人だと確認できていますか。お金はもう送りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you confirmed it really is your brother? Have you sent any money yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ送っていません。文面は似ていますが、いつもの番号ではないので不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送金で文面は似るが別番号なので不安と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. The wording seems similar, but I am worried because it is not his usual number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not transferred money and are worried despite similar wording because the number is different. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 以前から知っている連絡先で、本人への確認を考えましょう。届いた内容は消さずに残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's consider verifying with him through contact details you already know. Keep the messages without deleting them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いつもの番号へ電話します。今の相手に弟の誕生日を聞くだけでは、確認になりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 既知番号へ電話予定で誕生日質問だけで確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will call his usual number. Is simply asking this person my brother's birthday not enough to verify?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will call the known number and ask whether a birthday question alone verifies identity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 情報を答えられても、それだけで本人と決めつけないでください。あなたの情報を追加で教えることも控えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if they can answer personal information, do not conclude that alone proves their identity. Avoid giving additional information about yourself too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 質問は重ねず、やり取りを保存します。送金先として知らない口座番号も届きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問を重ねず保存し知らない送金先口座も届いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not ask more questions and will save the conversation. They have also sent an unfamiliar account number for the transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stop asking questions, save the conversation and have received an unfamiliar transfer account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 口座情報も含めて伺います。相手が指定した連絡先だけに頼らず、本人確認と相談を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will hear about the account information too. Proceed with verification and consultation without relying only on contact details the sender specifies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 口座情報も見せます。弟本人と連絡が取れるまで払わず、届いた経緯を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 口座と経緯を示し弟本人と連絡が取れるまで払わない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the account details too. I will not pay until I reach my actual brother, and will explain how the messages arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the account details and circumstances, and do not pay until you reach your real brother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 急かされても、その場で送金を決めないでください。それでは、保存したメッセージを相談担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Even if rushed, do not decide to transfer on the spot. Now please show the saved messages to the consultation staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの紙袋の品物を発送される予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to send the items in this paper bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族へガラスのコップを二つ送りたいです。店の袋のまま持参しましたが、この状態で発送できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ガラスコップ二つを店の紙袋で持参し発送可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to send two glass tumblers to my family. I brought them in the shop's bag. Can they be sent like this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought two glass tumblers in the shop's paper bag and ask if they can be sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 割れないよう梱包を見直す必要があります。コップ同士は触れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The packaging needs to be reconsidered to prevent breakage. Are the glasses touching each other?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一枚の紙でまとめて包んであります。別々に保護して丈夫な箱に入れたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一枚で包んだ物を個別保護して箱に入れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are wrapped together in one sheet of paper. Should I protect each separately and put them in a sturdy box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether items wrapped in one sheet should be protected separately and boxed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれを保護し、中で動かないようにしてください。梱包を確認する前には発送手続きを進められません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Protect each one and prevent movement inside. We cannot proceed with shipping before inspecting the packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 持ち帰って個別に包みます。「割れ物」と書けば簡単な包装でもよい、ということではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち帰り個別に包み割れ物表示だけで十分ではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take them home and wrap them separately. Just writing “fragile” does not make simple packaging sufficient, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will take them home and wrap separately, and confirm a fragile label alone is not sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示は梱包の代わりにはなりません。完成した状態で、重さと大きさ、利用できるサービスを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: A label does not replace packaging. Once packed, let's check the weight, size and available services.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 送料は箱を用意してから確かめます。もし途中で割れた場合の扱いも、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱準備後に送料を確認し破損時の扱いも先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the shipping charge after preparing the box. I also want to ask in advance what happens if they break in transit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check shipping after preparing a box and first ask about handling damage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 補償の対象や条件はサービスごとに確認してください。必ず補償されると今お約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the scope and conditions of compensation for each service. I cannot promise now that compensation is guaranteed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 梱包後に送料と補償条件を比べます。中身の状態を家族にも伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 送料と補償条件を比べ家族へ中身の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once packed, I will compare the charge and compensation conditions. I will also tell my family the condition of the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare shipping charges and compensation conditions and tell your family the condition of the contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 大切なお品物ですので、保護を整えてからお持ちください。それでは、袋のコップに気をつけてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: These are important items, so bring them after arranging protection. Please take care of the glasses in the bag on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込金額の記入についてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about entering the transfer amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求合計が三万円で、手数料は振込人負担とあります。金額欄に手数料も足すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三万円と振込人負担の記載を示し手数料加算の要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The invoice total is thirty thousand yen and says the sender pays the fee. Do I add the fee in the amount field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the thirty thousand yen and sender-pays-fee instruction and ask whether to add the fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人へ送る金額と、銀行へ支払う手数料を分けましょう。合計から手数料を引く指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's separate the amount sent to the recipient from the fee paid to the bank. Is there an instruction to deduct the fee from the total?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引く指定はありません。相手に三万円を送り、手数料は別にかかるという理解で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 減額指定なしで三万円送金と別途手数料の理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is no deduction instruction. I want to confirm my understanding that I send them thirty thousand yen and pay the fee separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that there is no deduction instruction and your understanding is thirty thousand yen sent plus a separate fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 請求内容を確認しましょう。手数料は振込方法などで変わります。どの方法を希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the invoice. The fee varies with the transfer method and other factors. Which method would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓口で口座から支払いたいです。必要な書類や持ち物も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口で口座から支払うため必要な書類を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to pay from my account at the counter. Please also tell me the required documents and items to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about documents required to pay from your account at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認などの手続きをご案内します。請求書の振込先と、ほかの指定も照合してから進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain identification and other procedures. Let's also match the invoice's destination details and other instructions before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 振込先はこの欄です。請求番号を依頼人名に加える指定もあります。入力できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 振込先を示し請求番号を名義に加える入力を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The recipient is in this field. It also says to add the invoice number to the sender name. Can that be entered?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the transfer destination and ask about entering the invoice number with the sender name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入力方法を確認します。指定の意味が不明なら、先に請求元へ問い合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check how to enter it. If the meaning of an instruction is unclear, ask the issuer before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号の指定を確かめます。三万円の送金と手数料を別々に確認してから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 請求番号の指定と三万円送金、別途手数料を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the number instruction. I will apply after separately confirming the thirty-thousand-yen transfer and the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the invoice-number instruction, thirty-thousand-yen transfer and separate fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 送金額と支払総額を区別してお確かめください。それでは、指定が確認できましたら、この窓口へお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please distinguish the transfer amount from the total payment. Once the instructions are confirmed, please speak to this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 精算前に、袋のご希望を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before payment, may I ask whether you need a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 袋はあります。冷凍食品を買いすぎたので、保冷用の袋があるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋はあるが冷凍品が多いため保冷袋の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a bag. I bought too many frozen foods, so I also want to know whether you have an insulated bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have a bag but many frozen items and ask if an insulated bag is available. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保冷用品の扱いを確認します。お帰りまでどのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check our cooling supplies. How long will it take to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 四十分ほど歩きます。保冷用品があっても、その時間で大丈夫と決めつけないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 徒歩四十分で保冷用品だけで状態を保証できないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will walk about forty minutes. Even with cooling supplies, I should not assume that time will be safe, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that a forty-minute walk is not guaranteed to keep items in good condition merely by using cooling supplies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保存については商品表示もご覧ください。持ち帰り中の状態を保証することはできません。まだ精算は始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also read the product storage instructions. We cannot guarantee their condition during the trip home. We have not started checkout yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このアイスは今日は買わないことにします。会計前に戻してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計前にアイスの購入をやめ返却を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not buy this ice cream today. Can you return it before checkout?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Cancel the ice cream before payment and ask for it to be returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 売り場への返却はこちらで対応します。残りのお買い物はこのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will return it to the sales area. Would you like to keep the rest of your shopping as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残りは買います。返却後の合計を確認してから、現金で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残りを購入し返却後合計確認のうえ現金で払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will buy the rest. After checking the total without the returned item, I will pay in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Buy the remaining items, check the total after return and pay cash. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 取りやめた分を除いた合計はこちらです。ご確認のうえ、現金でのお支払いをお願いします。袋詰めの際は、食品をつぶさないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the total excluding the cancelled item. Please check it and pay in cash. When packing, avoid crushing the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合計を確認して、現金で支払いました。袋に入れて寄り道せず帰ります。レシートも受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計を確認して現金で払い、袋詰め後は寄り道せず帰りレシートを受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the total and paid cash. I will pack the bag and go straight home without stopping. I will take the receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the total, pay cash, pack and go straight home without detours, and take the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらがレシートです。購入した品だけをお忘れなく、それではお荷物に気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the receipt. Remember to take only the items you bought, and please take care of your shopping on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 犬とご一緒ですね。利用案内についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have your dog with you. Are you asking about the use guidelines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 犬と短く散歩したいです。入口の表示を読み切れず、どこへ入ってよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬と短く散歩したいが立入区域がわからないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a short walk with my dog. I could not finish reading the sign at the entrance and do not know which areas we may enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want a short walk with your dog but do not know the permitted areas. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動物と入れる区域は利用案内で確かめましょう。今はリードをつけていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the guidelines for areas animals can enter. You have the dog on a lead now, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、つけています。子どもの多い遊具の区域を避けて歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リード装着済みで子どもが多い遊具区域を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I do. I would like to avoid the playground area where there are many children.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the lead is attached and you want to avoid the playground area with many children. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図で遊具と通路の位置を見比べましょう。犬と通れる範囲を確認してから経路を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare the playground and path locations on the map. Choose a route after confirming where you may walk with your dog.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 外側の通路がよさそうです。ただ、犬が入れるかを先に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外側通路を希望し犬の立入可否を先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The outer path looks good. But I will first check whether dogs can enter it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you prefer the outer path and will first check whether dogs are allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その通路の扱いを案内で確認します。歩くときは、ほかの利用者との距離にも気をつけましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check that path in the guidelines. When walking, also watch your distance from other users.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 落ち着かなくなったら先へ進まず戻ります。休憩中に水を飲ませたいのですが、場所の条件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 落ち着かなければ戻り給水休憩の場所条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the dog becomes unsettled, I will turn back instead of continuing. I want to give it water during a break. Are there conditions on the location?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will turn back if the dog becomes unsettled and ask about location conditions for a water break. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩場所での扱いも確認しましょう。犬をベンチへ乗せてよいとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the rules for rest areas too. Dogs are not necessarily allowed on benches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ベンチには乗せず、使える場所がわかってから休みます。帰りに戻れるよう、入口も覚えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 犬をベンチへ乗せず確認後休み入口位置を覚える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not put the dog on a bench, and will rest once I know which location is usable. I will remember the entrance too so I can return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the dog off benches, rest after checking and remember the entrance location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 人も犬も落ち着ける範囲を選んでください。それでは、案内を確認してから、リードをつけていってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-37208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Choose an area where both people and dogs can stay calm. After checking the guidelines, enjoy your walk with the lead attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その列車をお待ちでしたか。表示が更新されましたので、お手元の乗車券と一緒にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you waiting for that train? The display has been updated, so please check it together with your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この列車に乗ります。向こうの駅に友人が迎えに来るので、どの時刻を伝えればよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列車の時刻を知りたい理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am taking this train. A friend is meeting me at the station there, so I want to know which time to tell them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you want to know the train time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面の十時二十分は出発の見込みです。到着時刻と勘違いされる方もいますが、到着の見込みはまだ出ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The ten twenty on the screen is the estimated departure time. Some mistake it for arrival time, but no estimated arrival has been issued yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十時二十分に着くと思っていました。友人には、到着時刻はまだわからないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 迎えの友人へ到着未定と知らせるため掲示の出発時刻を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it arrived at ten twenty. I will tell my friend the arrival time is still unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Reread the posted departure time so you can tell your friend meeting you that arrival is undetermined. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのほうが行き違いを防げますね。お急ぎでしたら、次の列車も調べますが、どちらまで行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That should prevent confusion. If you are in a hurry, I can check the next train too. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 松山までです。友人も用事があるので、次の列車のほうが先に着くなら、そちらを考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の列車を検討する基準を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Matsuyama. My friend has things to do too, so if the next train arrives earlier I would consider it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your criterion for considering another train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いまの表示では、次の列車にも遅れが出ています。早く着けるとは言えないため、更新を見てから判断しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The current display shows that the next train is delayed too. We cannot say it will arrive earlier, so let's decide after seeing an update.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ決められないのですね。友人には駅で待たず、私から連絡するまで用事を済ませてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 到着が未定の間の行き違いを避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I cannot decide yet. I will ask my friend not to wait at the station, but to do their errands until I contact them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid a mix-up while the arrival time remains unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車前に表示をもう一度見てください。車内で連絡されるなら、発車前にメッセージを用意しておくと落ち着いて送れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the display again before boarding. If you will contact them on the train, preparing a message before departure will help you send it calmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 出発の案内が出たらもう一度確認して、乗ってから友人に連絡します。助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車前後の行動を具体的に決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: When departure information appears I will check again, then contact my friend after boarding. Thank you for your help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide concretely what to do before and after boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご友人と無事に合流できるとよいですね。列車が来ましたら、足元に気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you meet your friend without trouble. When the train arrives, please watch your step as you board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知をお持ちですね。表の宛名を隠したままで構いませんので、わからない箇所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought a notice. You may keep the addressee on the front covered; please show me the part you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日付までに何をするのか読めません。申請を出す日なのか、相談を受ける日なのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出期限と相談日を取り違えずに尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot read what I must do by this date. Is it the day to submit the application or the day to receive a consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask without confusing the submission deadline with the consultation date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この部分は提出に関する案内ですね。ただ、書類の内容は担当窓口で確認する必要があります。相談できる時間帯はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This part concerns submission. However, the department responsible needs to confirm the document's contents. Is there a time you could consult them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 平日は働いていますが、水曜日の昼なら休憩を長く取れそうです。短い相談でもできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談時間を調整する条件を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I work weekdays, but I may be able to take a longer lunch break on Wednesday. Is even a short consultation possible?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your conditions for arranging consultation time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談時間や予約の扱いを担当者に聞いてみます。通知のどの部分まで理解できたかを伝えると、相談を進めやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the staff about consultation length and bookings. Telling them which parts you have understood will make consultation easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所を書く欄はわかりました。添付するものの説明は難しいので、その部分をゆっくり説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明を必要とする範囲を絞る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understood the address field. The explanation of attachments is difficult, so I would like that part explained slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the part where you need an explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望も伝えましょう。日本語だけでは難しい場合に使える支援があるかどうかも、あわせて問い合わせられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's pass that request on too. We can also ask whether support is available if Japanese alone is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ベトナム語で確認できる方法があるか聞いてください。なければ、やさしい日本語で説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 理解できる支援の有無を問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please ask whether there is a way to check in Vietnamese. If not, I would like an explanation in easy Japanese.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about support you can understand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 希望をメモにしました。まだ予約が成立したわけではありませんので、担当窓口から日時の返答をもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have written down your wishes. A booking has not yet been made, so please obtain the date and time reply from the responsible counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水曜日に行けると決めつけず、返答を待ちます。通知の封筒と、読めない箇所のメモも持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当者の返答を待つ行動を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the reply rather than assume I can go Wednesday. I will bring the notice's envelope and a note of the parts I cannot read too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose to wait for the staff's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、このメモを担当窓口でお見せください。相談の日時が決まりましたら、気をつけてお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show this note at the responsible counter. Once the consultation date is fixed, take care on your way here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お帰りになる前に、何か気になることがありますか。次の方をお呼びするまでなら、お話を伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you leave, is there anything concerning you? I can listen until we call the next person.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社に休んだ理由を示す書類を出します。いまもらった領収書だけで足りるのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書で足りるか迷っている点を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I must submit a document to my company showing why I was absent. I am unsure whether the receipt I just received is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your uncertainty about whether the receipt is sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社が求める内容は私には判断できません。書類の名前などが書かれた、職場からの連絡はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I cannot decide what your company requires. Do you have a message from work specifying the document name or similar details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メールには、受診した日がわかるものとだけ書いてあります。病名まで必要かは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書類名や病名の必要性が未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The email only says something showing the date I received medical attention. It does not say whether the diagnosis is needed too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate that the document name and need for a diagnosis are unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、必要な記載内容を会社に確かめてから書類窓口に相談するとよいですね。不要な書類を申し込まずに済みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then it is best to check the required contents with your company before consulting the document desk. That avoids applying for an unnecessary document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に会社へ、日付だけでよいのか聞きます。もし診断書を求められたら、この場所で申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 診断書が必要な場合の相談先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will first ask the company whether the date alone is enough. If they request a medical certificate, can I apply here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to consult if a medical certificate is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込みは書類窓口でご相談ください。医師の確認が必要か、費用や受取りの時期も、そこで尋ねていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please consult the document desk about applying. You can also ask there whether the doctor must confirm it, the cost and when it can be collected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の朝までに会社へ提出するよう言われましたが、今日受け取れると約束はできないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日受取りが確約されないと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was told to submit it by tomorrow morning, but you cannot promise I will receive it today, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand that same-day collection is not guaranteed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、発行の見込みは窓口で確認してください。間に合わない場合にどうするかも、会社に相談しておくと安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Check the expected issue time at the desk. It is reassuring to discuss with your company what to do if it is not ready in time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書をなくさないようにしまい、会社に必要事項と提出日の相談をしてから、書類窓口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要な書類を確認してから申込みへ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the receipt away so I do not lose it, discuss the required details and submission date with my company, then go to the document desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the required document before proceeding to apply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お話の順序が整理できましたね。書類窓口はあちらですので、無理なさらず、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have put the order of discussion in place. The document desk is over there. Please do not overexert yourself, and get well soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 傘の忘れ物についてですね。どこで手放したか、思い当たる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a forgotten umbrella. Can you think of where you last left it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昼ごろ、パン屋の傘立てに置きました。店に戻ると見当たらず、店員さんからこちらにも聞くよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店で確認した後の相談だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Around noon I put it in the bakery's umbrella stand. When I returned it was not there, and a shop assistant told me to ask here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are consulting after checking with the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 傘の色や持ち手の形を教えてください。似た物があっても、持ち主の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please describe the color and handle shape. Even if we have a similar one, we need to verify ownership.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紺色の長い傘で、木の持ち手です。布の端に小さな白い傷があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 似た傘との照合に役立つ情報を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a long navy-blue umbrella with a wooden handle. There is a small white scuff on the edge of the fabric.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give information useful for matching it with similar umbrellas. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ほかに、見えにくい場所の目印はありますか。名前が書いてなくても、特徴を記録できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there any identifying marks in a less visible place? We can record features even without a written name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 留めるひもの裏に、黄色い糸を二針縫ってあります。家族の傘と区別するためにつけた印です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の傘を区別できる特徴を加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: On the back of the fastening strap I sewed two yellow stitches. It is a mark to distinguish it from my family's umbrellas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add a feature that distinguishes your umbrella. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その目印も記録します。いま届いている物の中に似た傘はありますが、確認前にあなたの物とはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record that mark too. There is a similar umbrella among those received, but we cannot tell you it is yours before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黄色い糸があるかを確認していただけますか。色が似ているだけなら、私の傘とは限らないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 似た色だけで所有物と判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you check whether the yellow thread is there? Just a similar color does not necessarily make it my umbrella.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not identify it as yours merely because the color is similar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認を担当する者に伝えます。あとで連絡が必要になったときのため、連絡先はこの欄にお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person handling the check. Please write your contact details in this field in case we need to contact you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらに電話番号を書きます。勤務中は出られないので、連絡があったら休憩中に折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勤務に合わせた折返し方法を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my phone number here. I cannot answer while working, so if you call I will return it during a break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain a callback method suited to your working hours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡の受け方も添えておきます。控えをなくさずお持ちください。傘が見つかるとよいですね、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will include how to contact you too. Please keep the receipt copy safely. I hope your umbrella is found. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票の宛名はご本人でしょうか。番号を確認しますので、票をこちらへ向けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the missed-delivery notice addressed to you? Please turn it toward me so I can check the number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私宛てです。引越し前の家に届いていて、昨日大家さんから受け取りました。まだ荷物を受け取れるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居前の家に届いた荷物の状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for me. It arrived at my old home, and I got it from the landlord yesterday. Can I still receive the parcel?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the situation of a parcel delivered to your former home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票の日付だけでは現在の保管状況を判断できません。番号で確認しますが、住所の変更はもうお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The notice date alone does not tell us the current storage status. We will check by number. Have you already changed your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 変更の手続きはしましたが、この票には前の住所が書かれています。新しい住所も伝えたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 照合に新住所が必要か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I completed the change procedure, but this notice shows the old address. Should I give you the new one too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the new address is needed for matching. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、照合のために伺います。ただし、この場で受取り先の変更ができるかは、荷物の扱いを確認してからのご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, for matching we will ask for it. But whether the delivery address can be changed here will be explained after checking the parcel's handling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい住所はこちらです。再配達を頼む前に、荷物がどこにあるのか確かめてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再配達より先に荷物の所在を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the new address. Before requesting redelivery, I want you to check where the parcel is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the parcel's whereabouts before redelivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在の所在を調べて、受取り方法をお伝えします。ご本人の受取りをお考えですか、それとも代理の方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will look up its present location and explain collection methods. Will you collect it yourself or use a representative?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今回は自分で受け取ります。窓口へ行く場合、どの窓口かと持参するものを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行く窓口と持参物を把握する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This time I will collect it myself. If I go to a counter, please tell me which one and what to bring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Find out the counter to visit and items to bring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 所在地と必要なものが確認できたら、紙に書いてお渡しします。先に別の窓口へ行かず、回答をお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once the location and requirements are confirmed, I will write them down for you. Could you wait for the reply rather than going to a different counter first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで確認結果を待ちます。受取り先と持ち物を見てから、仕事の予定に合う方法を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 所在が未確認のまま受取りへ向かわない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait here for the result. After checking the collection place and required items, I will choose a method that suits my work schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not head to collect while the location remains unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認結果のメモはこの票と一緒に保管してください。お受取りの際は、場所を確かめてお気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-38204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the note of the result together with this notice. When collecting, confirm the location and take care on your way there.
